description: Strassen-Lärm-Belastungs-Kataster (SLBK) is a dataset listed in Open Data Kanton Thurgau, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Kanton Thurgau, Tiefbauamt. Strassen-Lärm-Belastungs-Kataster für Haupt- und übrige Strassen. Er gibt Auskunft über die berechneten oder gemessenen Strassenlärmimmissionen an der Aussenseite angrenzender Gebäude. Coverage: Canton of Thurgau. The portal files it under Environment. Its keywords are geodaten, larmbelastung, verkehrslarm. The portal shows 2026-08-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-tg-ch-portal.
